title: Pair Finder
prompt: Write has_pair(numbers, target) returning True when ANY two DIFFERENT positions in numbers sum to target.

tests.name: pair detection
tests.code:
assert has_pair([1, 2, 4, 7], 9) is True, "2 + 7"
assert has_pair([1, 2, 4], 8) is False, "no pair makes 8"
assert has_pair([5], 10) is False, "cannot use the same position twice"
tests.hint: nested loop is fine at this level — j starts at i + 1 to avoid reusing a position.
